info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Rideshare Rides Routes-v2-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Routes Management API enables users to retrieve detailed information about rideshare routes available within the system. This endpoint is designed for fleet operators and application developers who need to access route data for analysis, operational planning, or integration into other systems. By providing insights into route selections, the API supports better decision-making and resource allocation in rideshare operations. Typical use cases include generating reports, enhancing user experiences, and integrating with navigation services.

get.summary: Fetch the optimal route for rides.
get.description: Retrieve the best route options for a specified ride, helping drivers and riders to navigate efficiently. This endpoint allows users to get real-time routing information based on current traffic conditions.

requestBody.description: Contains the parameters for retrieving a route for a ride. This request body should be formatted as JSON and includes necessary fields to specify the desired ride route.
